card.name: Small words inside dosing instructions
card.fires_on: Short filler words, digits and spaces in drug-label dosing text, often around insulin products. Examples are the 0 of 0.6 mg, a space before an age or day number, and small words like an, of, for, not, a.

modes.label: Numbers and spaces in doses
modes.description: A digit or space just before a dose amount, age range or day range.
modes.example: an additional <<0>>.6 mg dose of ZEGAL

modes.label: Small linking words near insulin
modes.description: A short word like an, of, a or for in sentences about insulin or similar injectable products.
modes.example: SOLIQUA 100/33 is<< a>> combination of insulin glargine and li
